results.name: dgm_evolve_one (n_gens=500, n_iter=30)
results.notes: baseline: 扫 best 全量; optimized: 增量 best + 增量 by_parent + sort 维护

results.name: archive_index (1 build + 50 incremental, n_gens=1000)
results.notes: baseline: 1 全量重建 (含 50 新 gen); optimized: 1 全量 + 50 增量 O(new). 增量场景优势 = O(n_increments)/O(n)

results.name: ucb1_select (n_arms=8, n_iter=5000)
results.notes: baseline: for+max 循环; optimized: 列表推导+max 一次, 预 log_total

results.name: replay_query (n_events=5000, n_tags=50)
results.notes: baseline: 线性 O(n); optimized: 反向索引 O(matches)

results.name: lru_vs_dict (n_keys=1000, capacity=256, 100 ops/iter)
results.notes: baseline: 无限 dict (无淘汰); optimized: LRU(cap=256) — hits=5093, misses=14907. LRU 价值在内存上限, 速度通常持平/略慢 (move_to_end 开销)

results.name: lru_hot_path (n_keys=200<capacity=256, 100 ops/iter)
results.notes: 小工作集场景: 命中率~100%, LRU 与 dict 速度相当. LRU 价值在内存可控

results.name: lru_get_only (warm, target=128 keys)
results.notes: baseline: dict 读 (直接 hash); optimized: LRU 读 (OrderedDict + move_to_end). 读路径 LRU 有微小开销

results.name: yaml_roundtrip (n_keys=50, n_iter=50)
results.notes: baseline: yaml.safe_dump + sort_keys=True; optimized: sort_keys=False 跳过 sort

results.name: token_estimation (n_chars=1000, n_iter=500)
results.notes: baseline: 每次 max(1, n//4); optimized: 同长度 text cache 命中

results.name: wal_append_verify (n_entries=1000, n_iter=20, warm cache)
results.notes: baseline: 每条重算 sha256; optimized: cache 跨调用命中 (warm). 真实 WAL 多次 verify 场景

results.name: dgm_branch_score (6 components, n_iter=100)
results.notes: baseline: for+max 循环 + 每条算 log; optimized: 预 log + 列表推导 max 一次

results.name: archive_json_codec (n_gens=500, in-memory)
results.notes: baseline: indent=2 + ensure_ascii=False; optimized: 紧凑 separators (省 CPU). 磁盘 I/O 另算

results.name: archive_disk_io (n_gens=500, n_iter=5)
results.notes: baseline: write_text+read_text (encoding 协商); optimized: write_bytes+read_bytes (省 encoding 协商 + 体积小)

results.name: lineage_walk (depth=50, n_iter=1000)
